program.section_heading: BROADCASTING Associate of Arts Degree (AA) (Program Code 060400, State Code 08549)
program.ge_pattern: Any GE (LACCD GE Plan or Cal-GETC)
outcomes: Students will evaluate the role and influence of broadcasting and streaming media in relation to radio, podcasting, television, and the Internet.
Students will explain the development and history of broadcasting, including radio, podcasting, television, and the Internet in the United States.
Students will write broadcast copy for audio and video, including news, sports, entertainment, promos, commercials, and public service announcements.
